_description: CCNL lavoro domestico, non convivente level CS (Tabella C), January 2026 regular run, permanent, 40 weekly hours.
_notes: Tabella C, livello CS, valori orari decorrenti dal 01/01/2026: 8,30.
CCNL 28/10/2025 chiarimento a verbale 1: monthly pay = hourly pay x weekly hours x 52 / 12; art. 14 c. 1 lett. b: at most 40 weekly hours for non conviventi.
No fixed allowance: Tabella C has no indennita column for non conviventi.
